name: Velvet Sky Waterfall
description: A waterfall that flows not with water but with a velvety, star‑strewn fabric, cascading into a pool of liquid night.
prompt: Massive waterfall made of flowing deep‑blue velvet fabric studded with tiny glowing stars. It descends into a dark pool reflecting the cosmos. Misty particles shimmer. Dramatic lighting, ultra‑detail, 8k, surreal fantasy.
caption: Dive into a cascade of dreams. 🌌💧 #VelvetSkyWaterfall
